summary: Sure is a self-hosted personal finance application derived from the Maybe project. It helps you manage, track, and organise your personal money, accounts, and budgeting data on your own infrastructure.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice if you want an open-source, self-hosted alternative for tracking personal finances and prefer containerised deployments.
watchOut: Being a fork in active development, it may undergo frequent changes and might lack the maturity or broad integration support of long-established commercial equivalents.
deployNotes: As a containerised application distributed via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
